description: Mathematical invariant: defender crew applies Hull Breach to attacker (duration 10 rounds). Defender has 100% crit chance, 2× multiplier. When attacker is hull-breached, defender's crit gets +1.5× HB bonus → effective crit = 3.5×. Defender deals 50×3.5 = 175 dmg/round vs 50×2.0 = 100 without HB. Attacker kills defender in round 5 (200×5=1000). Attacker takes 5 rounds of counter-fire: 175×5 = 875 total + includes Burning sub-procs from HB timing window.
